title: 電気電子プログラミング演習
subtitle: Programming Practice for Electrical and Electronic Engineers
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the fundamental concepts and methods of programming using C language. (2) learn how to solve problems and transform the solutions into computer programs written in C language. The goal of this course is to provide an introduction not just to C but also to logical thinking. (3) learn some applications of C programming in electrical and electronic engineering.
advice: This course is designed to familiarize students with computer programming, with an emphasis on a widely used language, C. The classes incorporate lecture with hands-on programming exercises. We will cover the following materials: 1. Elementary programming in C 2. Selection statements 3. Repetition statements 4. Arrays 5. Modular programming with functions 6. Pointers 7. Structures 8. File input/output 9. Using C in electrical and electronic engineering applications Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the detailed course schedules may change depending on the students' progress in understanding.
books: Textbooks: None Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: You are expected to bring your Windows laptop to class with you to work on programming exercises using Visual Studio. No prior programming knowledge is required. This course and “Computer Engineering for Electrical and Electronic Engineers” are complementary. “Electronic Circuits II” and “Feedback Control” are related to this course.

activityGoals.body: Be able to demonstrate problem-solving skills by developing algorithms to solve problems.
Be able to incorporate the selection and repetition control structures into C programs.
Be able to demonstrate understanding of the use of arrays and structures.
Be able to decompose the solution into modules at the function level.
Be able to demonstrate understanding of the use of pointers.
Be able to implement programs using file input/output.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Develop modular and efficient programs in C efficiently. (2) Identify a problem in electrical and electronic engineering and provide a proper solution by designing algorithms and implementing computer programs. (3) Be comfortable using C.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Design algorithms to solve rudimentary problems in electric and electronic engineering. (2) Demonstrate basic skills in writing and implementing simple structured programs in C. (3) Describe the fundamentals of C based on the hands-on knowledge of programming.
